description:
Implement the audited architecture in `docs/proposals/beadwork-minions-native-orchestration.md` as one coordinated major-version cutover.

## Outcome

Make `@solvedbydev/pi-minions` the in-process runtime for persistent background AgentSessions while the parent model remains the orchestration decision-maker and `@solvedbydev/pi-beadwork-extension` remains the durable goal/assignment/evidence/review/validation/acceptance authority. Execute complete single-epic workflows without tmux, polling, managed worktrees, landing, or the old worker registry.

## Non-negotiable boundaries

- Persistent Pi TUI/RPC hosts only; foreground `spawn` remains compatible.
- Shared current checkout is normal; path coordination is advisory, not locking.
- Children die with the parent process; no durable external worker fallback.
- Direct peer/parent messaging is nonblocking, bounded, same-group, and single-flight.
- Parent model chooses ready work, roles, review dispositions, remediation, and completion actions within frozen policy/capability ceilings.
- Minions owns live sessions, groups, mailboxes, lifecycle events, semantic effect-key enforcement, runtime limits, and cleanup.
- Beadwork owns canonical goal/ticket revisions, assignment/activity permits, durable records, review/validation gates, acceptance/close sagas, interruption, and migration.
- Ticket review is the default policy; normal review dispositions are autonomous; risk overrides and attention resumes are user-only.
- No production tmux/worktree/landing/supervisor path or compatibility shim remains after cutover.

## Delivery phases

### A. Runtime safety foundation

- Refactor child creation around owned `AgentSessionRuntime` handles.
- Add session-generation fencing, explicit group/child reducers, quiescence, normal close, halt/drain/dispose, and one terminal-event invariant.
- Compose the Pi post-turn stop hook for report/wait/mail boundaries.
- Add structured custom `sendMessage` delivery, bounded event coalescing, source-derived semantic effect keys, and absolute/renewable session limit accounting.
- Add capability intersections, extension allowlists, child protocol tools, and shell/trust caveats.

### B. One-ticket vertical slice

- Add nonblocking `orchestrate`, persistent groups, structured implementation results, and parent nudges.
- Add versioned runtime-validated Minions/Beadwork protocol channels.
- Add short same-host Git-common-dir goal ownership lock, durable goal revisions, canonical ticket-work assignments, one-use permits, attempt binding, and consumed-permit revoke/fence reconciliation.
- Add official sanitized-environment validation and recoverable ticket acceptance/close saga.
- Complete one real ticket under `review.policy: none` without tmux/polling/landing.

### C. Full V1 workflow

- Add ticket/scope review and auxiliary activity permits, immutable Git entry manifests (OID/absence/mode), exact result binding, findings, fix/file/reject, remediation generations, and frozen allowed roles.
- Add direct messaging/wait restart, advisory path overlap, Minions fleet UI, Beadwork goal UI, exact-tree/dependency-set review validity, validation wave coverage, and user-only bounded resumes/overrides.
- Add recursive dependency-aware ticket acceptance and epic completion; no dependent dispatch before `accept-committed`.
- Pass separate ticket-policy and scope-policy full epic fixtures.

### D. Major-version cutover

- Remove `beadwork_delegate`, `beadwork_worker_done`, tmux bootstrap/control, worker registry/runtime execution truth, worker wrapper scripts, managed worktree lifecycle, landing, supervisor polling, process inspection, and obsolete dashboard actions.
- Split the current monolithic orchestrator into goal intent/assignment/projection/evidence/review/validation/acceptance/decision modules.
- Implement field-by-field JSON/environment migration, including the one-release `maxContextChars` alias and explicit legacy `in_progress` disposition workflow.
- Update docs, TUI labels, examples, tool prompts, and migration diagnostics.

## Acceptance criteria

- Parent remains responsive while orchestrated children run.
- Exactly one terminal event per child; group close emits only after every child is terminal and disposed.
- Mail arriving at the final prompt boundary is claimed or gets an inspectable undelivered outcome; restart failures terminalize and dispose.
- Fresh model-supplied nonces cannot duplicate autonomous effects; limits cannot be reset by group rotation or resume.
- Every domain-group task requires an exact, unexpired ticket/activity permit; permit consume/revoke races are acknowledged and fenced.
- Concurrent same-host `/bw run` calls serialize goal ownership before permits; ticket collisions reconcile visibly.
- Review records bind exact subject, reviewer assignment/attempt, policy, entry tombstones/modes, and complete dependency coverage or fall back to whole-tree validity.
- Validation runs in a deny-by-default effective environment and records command, tree, environment, executable/toolchain, config/lockfile, output, and before/after fingerprints.
- Ticket and epic closure use prepared/external-command/reread/committed sagas with crash fault-injection coverage and no false success.
- Interrupt/abandon fence the runtime before durable state claims; resume creates bounded new authorization/goal generations without resetting absolute counters.
- Legacy unowned `in_progress` issues cannot schedule until explicitly adopted, returned open, excluded/deferred, or abandoned.
- `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, both full epic fixtures, compatibility tests, and manual TUI smoke test all pass.
- No production path invokes tmux, managed worktrees, landing, supervisor polling, old worker tools, or stale registry execution.

## Execution guidance

Treat the proposal as normative. Create phase/task children with explicit dependencies before implementation. Phases A-D are one cutover train: do not publish a Beadwork release that removes tmux before the full native epic fixture passes, and do not retain tmux as a fallback after release.
title: Replace Beadwork worker subsystem with native Minions orchestration
